## Game artwork

- **`assets/32x32folk.png`:** The pinned AI Town repository distributes this
  sprite sheet with its MIT license; the upstream README credits pixel-art
  generation via Replicate and Fal.ai. No separate asset license or creator
  attribution is supplied for this specific file.
- **`assets/gentle-obj.png`:** The map tileset includes art credited by the
  upstream README to
  [16x16 Game Assets by George Bailey](https://opengameart.org/content/16x16-game-assets)
  (CC BY 4.0) and
  [16x16 RPG Tileset by hilau](https://opengameart.org/content/16x16-rpg-tileset)
  (CC BY-SA 3.0 or GPL-3.0). Hilau's attribution notice says that work is
  based on George Bailey's tileset and
  [LPC Thatched-roof Cottage by bluecarrot16](https://opengameart.org/content/lpc-thatched-roof-cottage)
  (CC BY-SA 3.0 or GPL-3.0); bluecarrot16 credits LPC base art by Lanea
  Zimmerman, Daniel Armstrong, and Casper Nilsson (CC BY-SA 3.0 or GPL-3.0+).
  The upstream map image is retained unmodified. Credit the contributors as:
  “Uses the ‘16x16 RPG Tileset’ by hilau, based on ‘16x16 Game Assets’ by
  George Bailey and ‘LPC Thatched-roof Cottage’ by bluecarrot16.” The CC
  licenses permit redistribution with attribution; adaptations of the
  CC-BY-SA material must retain the applicable share-alike terms.
- Other upstream artwork (including the animated effect sheets and UI art) is
  not bundled because the pinned repository does not provide a file-specific
